turns.replyText:
Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
The cheaper MOISSANITE Everlasting Love Engagement Ring ($94) is more than enough if you want real VVS D-color moissanite that passes diamond testers in solid 925 sterling silver.
The pricier MOISSANITE Sqaure Iced Out Chicago Ring ($211) justifies its higher price tag with significantly more raw material—it uses 2 carats of moissanite instead of 1.2 carats and features a much heavier 8-9 gram solid silver band.
If you are looking for a classic, subtle style, the cheaper $94 option offers incredible value. If you want a bold, heavy statement piece with maximum stone coverage, the $211 option is worth the upgrade.
